title: Q-WORKERS-247: Claims are code: core/statements, every published statement bound to a probe
body:

**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/statements/statements.test.js
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#247 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

Owner role: platform engineer. Done check: `node --test core/statements/statements.test.js` passes and Practical Solutions /method renders only from the registry (CI fails on a claim with no passing probe or on unbound prose). Closing probe: `GET /claims.json` on the tenant lists every statement with ok=true.

Problem: published methodology text drifted from the code (e.g. a GiveWell route that does not exist, "no model" while a red-team model route runs). Rowan, 2026-11-17: every statement on Ultrastable pages must be 100% implemented as written.

Claim: coordinator thread, 2026-11-17 (Sonnet 5.5).

**Closing probe:** `file:workers/core/statements/statements.test.js`
